request.prompt:
Goods: POLARIZED SUNGLASSES
Country of origin: IT

Chosen so far: 90 Optical, photographic, cinematographic, measuring, checking, medical or surgical instruments and apparatus; parts and accessories

Choose the heading that covers these goods. Options:
- 9004: Spectacles, goggles and the like; corrective, protective or other
    contains 900410: Sunglasses; corrective, protective or other
    contains 900490: Spectacles, goggles and the like; (other than sunglasses) corrective, protective or other
- 9001: Optical fibres and optical fibre bundles; optical fibre cables not of heading no. 8544; sheets, plates of polarising material; lenses, prisms, mirrors, of any material; unmounted; not non optical glass
    contains 900120: Optical elements; polarising material, sheets and plates thereof
    contains 900140: Lenses, spectacle; unmounted, of glass, excluding elements of glass not optically worked
    contains 900150: Lenses, spectacle; unmounted, of materials other than glass
- 9003: Frames and mountings; for spectacles, goggles or the like, and parts
    contains 900311: Frames and mountings; for spectacles, goggles or the like, of plastics
    contains 900319: Frames and mountings; for spectacles, goggles or the like, of materials other than plastics

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: Polarized sunglasses are finished spectacles of the sunglasses type, covered by heading 9004 (subheading 900410), not unmounted polarising elements, lenses or frames alone.
